item.title: Ice Rescue in Detroit Harbor near Washington Island Ferry Dock
item.description: Adam Collins -- Emergency crews responded to an ice rescue incident approximately 1,000 feet from the Washington Island Ferry Dock after a vehicle broke through the ice Saturday.

item.title: Crossroads handles weather whiplash
item.description: By Coggin Heeringa, Crossroads at Big Creek -- At Crossroads, we've been experiencing a bit of weather whiplash this winter a thaw one day, sleet rattling the windows the next. In Door County, that's hardly surprising.

item.title: Warm Weather Adds a Nice Twist on Fire & Ice Festival
item.description: Adam Collins -- The annual Fire & Ice Festival took over downtown Sturgeon Bay on Saturday, with a full slate of winter-themed activities.

item.title: Belgian Heritage Center celebrates Brice’s canonization process
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- The Belgian Heritage Center in Brussels is among the many local organizations closely following developments involving one of the area's most well-known immigrants.

item.title: Olympic Spotlight Sparks Cross-Country Skiing in Door County
item.description: Adam Collins -- With the Winter Olympics now underway, interest in cross-country skiing is gaining momentum across Door County.

item.title: Infrastructure replacement projects set to begin at Potawatomi State Park
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- Visitors should not be surprised if parts of Potawatomi State Park begin to look like a construction zone this week.

item.title: One primary on the ballot for local voters
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- If you live in Wards 1 or 2 in Baileys Harbor, or Ward 2 in Jacksonport, grab your photo ID and head to the polls.

item.title: Jacque proud of work of Speaker’s Task Force on Protecting Kids
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- Your kids may find it harder to log onto some social media platforms but easier to cope with some of the mental health challenges that can come with them following the passage of several bills out of committee last week.

item.title: Historic preservation code amendments, permanent zoning gets second reading
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- A pair of ordinances first introduced earlier this month will receive a second reading Tuesday at the Sturgeon Bay Common Council's regularly scheduled meeting.

item.title: Winter activities take hit from warm stretch
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- Without a little help from Mother Nature, you might as well start putting your snowmobiles, sleds, skates and skis into storage.
